As Microsoft (MSFT) Stock Price Rose, Pax World Management Increased Position; Founders Capital Management Increases Position in Disney Walt Co (DIS)
June 27, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Founders Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Disney Walt Co (DIS) by 6.98% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Founders Capital Management Llc bought 5,106 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.93% with the market. The institutional investor held 78,294 shares of the television services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $7.72 million, up from 73,188 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Founders Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Disney Walt Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $154.55B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.30% or $0.31 during the last trading session, reaching $103.95. About 7.50 million shares traded. The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) has declined 4.73% since June 27, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.30% the S&P500.
